pages.text: The Fusion Reactor provides endgame power: one unit exceeds an entire reactor array, and it has the most complex structure in the mod.$(br2)It burns $(l:akaishi:plasma)plasma fuel rods$(/l); the fuel chain should be reviewed before construction.$(br2)$(bold)Two outputs:$(reset)$(li)Large amounts of akaishi energy, split evenly among the energy output ports$(li)Life Ash, produced at a rate proportional to consumption, used by late-game life technology$(br2)The 7×7×7 layered structure on the next page must be assembled first.

The structure has four layers: outer 7×7×7 shell → 5×5×5 insulation → 3×3×3 frame → exactly 1 Fusion Core at the center.$(br2)$(bold)The controller is a wall block:$(reset) it replaces any one shell on any outer wall, including sides, top, bottom, corners and edges. The build is sized from that wall: 6 blocks deep inward and ±3 blocks along the other two axes. The bottom 3 levels are also filled, with no floating or buried structure.$(br2)$(bold)Layer rules:$(reset)$(li)Outer shell: Fusion Shell throughout; the controller, Energy Output, Item Input and Item Output ports may replace shell spots$(li)Insulation: all 98 spots must be Fusion Insulation; one gap voids the structure$(li)Frame cavity: the 26 spots may remain empty; insert Fuel (≤4), Cooler (≤10) and Efficiency (≤12) frames$(li)Center: exactly 1 Fusion Core$(br2)When built correctly the controller shows formed within about a second; breaking any required block collapses it immediately.

$(bold)Output:$(reset) each fuel slot drains energy at rod base yield × 1.15^efficiency frames; 12 efficiency frames give approximately 5.35×. Produced energy is split evenly across all energy output ports (20 billion buffer each, output only).$(br2)$(bold)Temperature model:$(reset) target = 50M + Σ heat value × efficiency multiplier − cooling; cooling = (Σ heat-sink efficiency% × (1 + 0.1 × cooler-frame count) + rod cooling) × 2M, where Σ counts only sinks placed in unlocked slots on the controller's Heat page (max 10).$(br2)Heat sinks are stored in the controller and inserted or removed via the Heat page; cooler frames determine how many slots unlock and amplify cooling.$(br2)Each tick the actual temperature moves 2% toward the target, clamped at ±2M per step.

$(bold)Optimal range: 100M-130M, yield ×1.0$(reset). Below 100M the yield varies with temperature; above 130M it decreases linearly, reaching ×0.5 at the 160M theoretical peak, which is not attainable:$(br2)exceeding 159M triggers the overheat shutdown: burning stops, an explosion does not occur, and the reactor remains shut down for a forced 5-minute cooldown.$(br2)For full output, the temperature must be kept between 100M and 130M; the yield multiplier determines the power obtained from each rod.

Fusion heat sinks have five tiers:$(li)tier1: 5%$(li)tier2: 7%$(li)tier3: 9%$(li)tier4: 12%$(li)tier5: 15%$(br2)The $(bold)Life Heat Sink$(reset) (fusion_heat_sink_life) provides 20%, the highest grade, crafted from Life Ash.$(br2)$(bold)Usage:$(reset) right-click the controller and place sinks into the grid on its Heat page; each Cooler Frame inside the structure unlocks one slot (max 10) and scales total cooling by (1 + 0.1 × frames).$(br2)Each sink has 8,000 durability and loses 1 every 100 ticks while running or cooling down; at zero it is destroyed. Sinks must be restocked for long-term operation.

Burning produces $(bold)Life Ash$(reset): 1 ash per 100 billion akaishi energy consumed.$(br2)Ash is output automatically through the Fusion Item Output Port; connecting an item pipe prevents it from accumulating in the core.$(br2)It is used by the Life Heat Sink and by Mother Altar life technology, which are covered in Secrets of Life.
Reading order: the Energy Generator, then heat control on the Reactor, then Fuel & Cooling, then rod production via the Plasma Chain, and finally the Fusion Reactor.
